_note: Each uploaded still becomes the approved keyframe anchor for one scene. Later scenes must begin from the previous scene's last frame without a style reset.

episode.basis: uploaded still lock -> motion-ready keyframes -> sequential scene-video generation

continuityRules.entryFrameRule: scene-01 starts from the uploaded anchor still; later scenes start from the previous scene's final frame state
continuityRules.boundaryRule: scene-n final frame and scene-(n+1) opening frame must be the same state before motion continues
continuityRules.identityRule: Jjiroo, Jjonga, mother proportions, and riverside geography must stay unchanged across the episode
continuityRules.actionDriftFallback: if sprinting, splash, or water chase beats drift identity, keep the motion shorter and more controlled rather than widening the action

keyframes.pose: walk setup with Jjiroo, Jjonga, and the mother together on the bright Tancheon path
Jjiroo freezing and focusing on ducks near the riverbank while the world remains calm for a beat
Jjiroo bursting forward with the mother reacting behind and Jjonga staying secondary
Jjiroo diving into the river with a strong splash and ducks escaping ahead
Jjiroo paddling quickly through the water with ducks still out of reach
the mother splashing into the river while Jjiroo stays ahead of her
Jjiroo climbing out of the river by himself, dripping but calm
Jjiroo on shore giving the soaked mother a puzzled innocent final look
